The `rollout undo` command reverts the deployment to the previous known state (e.g., `v2` of the image).

To rollback the Deployment from the current version to the previous version, you can use the command `kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment` or specify a revision with `kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment --to-revision=<revision_number>`.

If you set the `type` field to `NodePort`, the Kubernetes control plane allocates a port from a range specified by the `--service-node-port-range` flag (default: 30000-32767).
